notes.curiosity: The film opens on a riddle ('who taught it?') and keeps adding open questions (who paid for dinner, can a fence around chips hold, how far and how fast) that pull a viewer through 36 minutes. It ends on an honest open file and a dark lantern rather than a tidy verdict.
